parameters.name: NodeType
parameters.description:
The node type. This parameter is required when you query the PolarDB search node account.

*   Search

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the page to return. Set this parameter to an integer that is larger than 0. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values:

*   **30**
*   **50**
*   **100**

Default value: **30**.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb describe-accounts --db-cluster-id pc-000000000000000 --account-name test_acc --node-type Search --page-number 1 --page-size 30 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun polardb DescribeAccounts --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 30 --PageNumber 1 --NodeType Search --DBClusterId 'pc-000000000000000' --AccountName test_acc
